headline: Foundations are the bottleneck: Data Platform and AI Governance delays now hold up three AI go-lives. Four decisions needed by 11 Nov.
key_messages: Value is proven where AI is live: invoice automation runs 64% touch-free and the service copilot cuts handle time 11% in pilot.
Delivery risk has moved to the foundations: the product catalogue (DAT-02) and the customer-facing AI checklist (GOV-03) together block CS Copilot, Demand Forecasting and the Proposal Generator.
Both bottlenecks are capacity problems with small fixes: a contractor extension and 3 product FTE for data, one Responsible AI lead for governance.

portfolio_risks.title: Product catalogue delay stalls three AI go-lives
portfolio_risks.impact_statement: Copilot wave 2 slips to December and forecasting may miss the S/S 2027 cycle (~€1M benefit deferred ~6 months); losing contractors on 31 Oct pushes the catalogue into January.
portfolio_risks.recommended_action: CFO approves contractor SOW extension by 24 Oct; Product Management releases 3 FTE for data quality; DAT-02 delivers the SKU mapping table first.

portfolio_risks.title: Governance capacity blocks customer-facing AI
portfolio_risks.impact_statement: No customer-facing GenAI go-live before 11 Nov at the earliest; the €1.4M proposal benefit is on hold and mandatory Responsible AI training slips into 2027.
portfolio_risks.recommended_action: Exec committee funds a Responsible AI lead; run a joint CRM-01/SAL-08 checklist dry run before the 11 Nov approval meeting.

portfolio_risks.title: Users bypass AI output; training timing drifts
portfolio_risks.impact_statement: Benefits depend on agents and planners acting on AI output; training booked against moving go-live dates will need rebooking and won't stick.
portfolio_risks.recommended_action: Lock go-live dates before booking training; extend the champions network to supply chain planners.

portfolio_risks.title: 2027 AI run costs rising across vendors
portfolio_risks.impact_statement: A 12% document-AI price rise, ~10% model token uplift, the unfunded €65k sandbox and €90k app upgrades all land in 2027.
portfolio_risks.recommended_action: Consolidate AI run costs into one 2027 budget line; Procurement negotiates the FIN-04 renewal before March.

portfolio_risks.title: AI compliance gaps: monitoring and shadow AI
portfolio_risks.impact_statement: Manual monitoring won't scale past ~10 production use cases, and unknown AI inside third-party SaaS creates EU AI Act exposure.
portfolio_risks.recommended_action: Fund monitoring tooling in the 2027 budget round; Procurement adds AI questions to vendor onboarding by end of November.

portfolio_risks.title: Legacy warehouse renews at ~€420k
portfolio_risks.impact_statement: If migrations miss 1 Mar 2027, the old warehouse licence renews for another year at about €420k.
portfolio_risks.recommended_action: Take a go/no-go on decommission in January from the customer-domain forecast; negotiate a short extension option now.

portfolio_risks.title: Partner identity delays copilot for Tallinn
portfolio_risks.impact_statement: Outsourced agents go live 1 Feb 2027 at the earliest instead of 11 Jan.
portfolio_risks.recommended_action: CISO chooses the interim partner-identity option this month.

decisions_required: CFO: approve the Data Platform contractor SOW extension by 24 Oct
Sponsor: confirm Copilot wave 2 waits for the new knowledge index (7 Dec) so training is rebooked by 25 Oct
Product Management: release 3 FTE for a six-week data quality sprint, SKU mapping first
Exec committee: fund a Responsible AI lead and a joint CRM-01/SAL-08 checklist dry run before 11 Nov
